ag.agent-d.d: Brings whatever he imagines into reality: objects, structures, temporary creatures.
ag.darius-brooks.d: Animates and controls inorganic objects: metal, stone, wood, furniture.
ag.kwame-abara.d: Transforms partially or fully into an animal (crocodile, lion, raptor and more).
ag.noah-kaplan.d: Swaps places with an object or a person within sight.
ag.freya-lindqvist.d: Reads and transmits thoughts, and communicates at a distance by mind alone.
ag.giulia-rossi.d: Moves, lifts and hurls objects with the power of thought.
ag.tunde-oyelaran.d: Creates temporary or permanent dimensional spaces to store, hide or trap.
ag.lucas-mendes.d: Lets matter pass straight through the body, at the cost of being unable to strike or be struck.
ag.rin-takeda.d: Emits, captures, jams and manipulates electromagnetic waves (radio, Wi-Fi, electricity).
ag.amara-hughes.d: Senses and influences the emotions of crowds or individuals, to soothe, excite or focus.
ag.ilona-varga.d: Gives a physical, tangible form to the fears of targets.
ag.louis-dubois.d: Creates and controls magnetic fields, pulling or pushing metal and charged objects.
ag.ada-okonkwo.d: Manipulates the DNA of living beings: heal, mutate, speed up or slow down biological processes.
ag.victor-sorel.d: Takes control of targets' minds for a limited time.
ag.fatou-diallo.d: Turns kinetic energy into projectiles, shields and barriers.
ag.clement-lefevre.d: Creates visual and audio illusions that fool targets' senses.
ag.youssef-haddad.d: Sharpens every sense tenfold: sight, hearing, smell, touch and a “sixth sense”.
ag.marco-bellini.d: Transforms the composition of an object or material with a simple touch.
ag.severine-morel.d: Absorbs targets' life energy to heal or grow stronger.
ag.ji-hoon-park.d: Turns body and gear invisible, without erasing sounds or smells.
ag.agent-m.d: Perceives the past, present and future of everything around her.
ag.sam-okafor.d: Absorbs blows and kinetic energy, then releases it as a shockwave or a burst of strength.
ag.astrid-hallstrom.d: Manipulates water in all its forms, from rain to steam.
ag.celeste-moreau.d: Produces and spreads gases with varied effects: toxic, anesthetic or euphoric.
ag.anna-petrov.d: Teleports over short and medium distances, to places already known.
ag.haruto-nakamura.d: Separates mind from body to explore, spy or act from afar.
ag.eero-nieminen.d: Raises or lowers gravity locally, to crush targets or move through the air.
ag.mateo-vasquez.d: Controls blood, targets' or their own: stop a hemorrhage, force clotting, or make it flow.
ag.zofia-kowalczyk.d: Creates, amplifies, distorts or cancels sound. Can produce destructive waves.
ag.odile-ferrand.d: Slows down or speeds up time in a limited area.
ag.yelena-ivanova.d: Creates and controls ice and intense cold: frost, crystals, barriers.
ag.kraken.d: Tentacles that grab, crush and hurl. Senses vibrations in water and ground.
ag.mante.d: Energy blades on the forearms, short flight on translucent wings, heightened reflexes.
ag.caprin.d: Levitates and moves rocks and crystals. Great physical strength.
ag.phalene.d: Silent flight, perfect night vision, and draws and concentrates light to dazzle.
ag.famine.d: Absorbs the heat of living beings. The hungrier, the bigger the body grows and the harder the skin gets.
ag.pied-grand.d: Colossal strength, great leaps, and ground slams that cause small tremors.
ag.lupin.d: Partial or full transformation into a wolfdog. Extreme sense of smell, powerful bites.
ag.pierre.d: Stone skin that withstands impacts. Freezes into a statue to avoid blows.
ag.suceur.d: Lightning-fast four-legged sprint, retractable fanged jaws, a sense of smell that detects blood from miles away.
